summary: This is a prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 4,348,000 common shares by Mayville Engineering Company, Inc. at $20.00 per share, raising gross proceeds of ~$87M. The offering is underwritten by William Blair, Craig-Hallum, and Northland Capital Markets, with a 30-day greenshoe option for up to 652,000 additional shares. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation event. The filing describes standard underwriting arrangements and use of proceeds; no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements are present.
